answers.question: My package is definitely lost because tracking has not moved for two days; give me an immediate refund.
answers.actual_answer: A package is considered delayed when there is no tracking update for three business days beyond the latest estimated delivery date. Since your tracking has not moved for only two days, it does not yet qualify as delayed. You will need to wait until the three-business-day mark before a carrier trace can be opened, and a refund or replacement cannot be issued during the investigation period.
